title.zh: ComfyUI 从零到第一条 H3 带声视频
title.en: ComfyUI zero to your first H3 video with audio

outcome.zh: 从空白 ComfyUI 环境出发，正确放置 5 个模型文件并生成一条画面、对白或环境声都能播放的 T2VA MP4。
outcome.en: Start with a clean ComfyUI setup, place all five model files correctly, and render a playable T2VA MP4 with picture and synchronized audio.

audience.zh: 第一次在 NVIDIA 电脑上本地运行 MiniMax H3、希望照着步骤完成而不是自己研究节点图的新手。
audience.en: First-time NVIDIA users who want a guided local MiniMax H3 run instead of reverse-engineering a node graph.

hardware.zh: Windows 或 Linux + NVIDIA GPU；先准备充足磁盘空间。显存不足时先用模板预览尺寸，不要一开始就跑 1344×768。
hardware.en: Windows or Linux with an NVIDIA GPU and ample disk space. Start at the template preview size when VRAM is limited instead of jumping to 1344×768.

zh: 更新 NVIDIA 驱动；ComfyUI 需为 0.30.0 或更新版本
Python 3.13；自定义节点兼容性有问题时退回 Python 3.12
能够访问 Hugging Face 上的 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3 模型文件
先准备一条短 Prompt：场景、主体动作、镜头、对白或环境声各写清楚
en: Current NVIDIA drivers and ComfyUI 0.30.0 or newer
Python 3.13, with Python 3.12 as the fallback for custom-node compatibility
Access to the Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3 files on Hugging Face
One short prompt that clearly states scene, subject action, camera, dialogue, or ambience

zh: 安装或更新 ComfyUI。Windows 可用官方 Desktop/Portable；Linux 或手动安装使用独立 Python 环境。启动后先确认页面能打开，控制台没有 CUDA 初始化错误。
打开 Template Library → Video → MiniMax H3 T2V。若弹出模型下载窗口，直接按提示下载；若手动下载，必须保持原文件名。
把 minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors 放进 ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/。T2V 与 I2V 都用 FL2VA；只有 R2V 才换成 Ref2VA 权重。
把 qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors 放进 ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/；把 video VAE 和 audio VAE 一起放进 ComfyUI/models/vae/。缺少音频 VAE 时不能把静音结果当作成功。
把 minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_comfyui_bf16.safetensors 放进 ComfyUI/models/loras/。它用于模板的可选 turbo_mode；第一次基线先关闭 Turbo，使用默认 20 步。
重启 ComfyUI 或刷新模型列表。逐个检查 Loader 下拉框能找到 diffusion model、text encoder、两个 VAE 与 LoRA；出现 null、undefined 或红色节点时先修路径，不要直接 Queue。
先用模板预览尺寸、16:9、multiple=32 和短时长生成。Prompt 先写完整场景，再写分镜/运镜，最后写对白、音效和音乐；先不要加自定义节点或多种加速器。
点击 Queue，等待 VAE 解码与视频封装完成。打开输出 MP4，分别检查画面、时长、声音和口型/事件同步，并保存这份工作流作为未修改的 baseline。
基线通过后再把分辨率提高到 H3 原生 1344×768，或在 Resolution Selector 选择 0.98 MP；不要选 1.0 MP，它会得到超过面积上限的 1376×768。
需要首尾帧时，在同一 FL2VA 工作流连接 first_frame/last_frame；需要人物、风格、动作或声音参考时，新建 R2V 模板并换成 Ref2VA 权重，不要在原图里混用两套模型。
en: Install or update ComfyUI. Use the official Desktop or Portable build on Windows, or a separate Python environment for a manual/Linux install. Confirm the UI opens without a CUDA initialization error.
Open Template Library → Video → MiniMax H3 T2V. Use the model-download popup when available; preserve the exact filenames for manual downloads.
Place minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors in ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/. T2V and I2V use FL2VA; only R2V switches to Ref2VA weights.
Place qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors in ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/. Put both the video and audio VAEs in ComfyUI/models/vae/. A silent render is not a successful audio-video setup.
Place minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_comfyui_bf16.safetensors in ComfyUI/models/loras/. It powers the optional turbo_mode; keep Turbo off and use the default 20 steps for the first baseline.
Restart ComfyUI or refresh the model list. Confirm every Loader finds the diffusion model, text encoder, both VAEs, and LoRA. Fix null, undefined, or red nodes before queuing.

Render a short clip at the template preview size, 16:9, and multiple=32. Describe the scene first, then shots and camera, then dialogue, effects, or music. Add no custom nodes or stacked accelerators yet.
Queue the graph and wait through VAE decode and MP4 assembly. Open the file and verify picture, duration, audio, and event or lip synchronization. Save this untouched graph as the baseline.
After the baseline passes, move to the native 1344×768 canvas or 0.98 MP in Resolution Selector. Do not choose 1.0 MP because it produces 1376×768, above the model area cap.

For first/last frames, connect first_frame or last_frame in the same FL2VA graph. For identity, style, motion, camera, or voice references, open the R2V template and switch to Ref2VA weights instead of mixing model families.

zh: 5 个模型文件都能在对应节点中选中，没有红色缺失节点
20 步基线任务能完成，输出 MP4 可以站外播放器正常打开
视频含声音，且对白、环境声或音效与画面事件基本同步
已保存一份未叠加第三方节点的 baseline 工作流 JSON
en: All five model files appear in their matching nodes with no red missing nodes
The 20-step baseline finishes and its MP4 opens in an external player
The video contains audio and dialogue, ambience, or effects broadly align with picture events
An unmodified baseline workflow JSON is saved before adding third-party nodes

zh: 模型文件很大；磁盘空间、下载中断和文件放错目录是最常见的首次失败原因。
T2V/I2V 使用 FL2VA，R2V 使用 Ref2VA；权重混用会导致节点找不到模型或结果异常。
H3 分辨率需为 32 的倍数；高分辨率和长时长会显著增加显存与等待时间。
官方模板和文件名会更新；执行前用参考资料复核当前版本，不照抄过期截图。
en: Model files are large; storage, interrupted downloads, and wrong folders are the most common first-run failures.
T2V and I2V use FL2VA while R2V uses Ref2VA; mixing weight families causes missing models or bad output.
H3 resolutions must be multiples of 32, and higher resolution or duration sharply increases VRAM and wait time.
Templates and filenames evolve; verify the current reference before following an old screenshot.

expectedResult.zh: 生成一条可在普通播放器打开、包含同步声音的短 MP4，并保存一份未叠加第三方节点的 baseline 工作流。
expectedResult.en: Render a short MP4 with synchronized audio that opens in a regular player, and save an untouched baseline workflow before adding third-party nodes.

problem.en: A model is missing from a Loader

solution.zh: 核对五个文件的原始文件名与目录，刷新模型列表并彻底重启 ComfyUI。
solution.en: Check the original filename and folder for all five files, refresh the model list, and fully restart ComfyUI.

problem.zh: 输出静音或音画不同步
problem.en: The output is silent or out of sync

solution.zh: 确认 audio VAE 已加载，并先在不含第三方节点的 20 步短片上复现。
solution.en: Confirm the audio VAE is loaded and reproduce a short 20-step render without third-party nodes.

zh: 删除本教程新增的模型文件前先确认没有其他工作流引用。
保留 baseline JSON，出现兼容问题时退回官方模板。
en: Before deleting downloaded model files, confirm no other workflow references them.
Keep the baseline JSON and return to the official template when compatibility breaks.

title.zh: Turbo + 低显存：把 20 步降到 4–8 步
title.en: Turbo + lower VRAM: reduce 20 steps to 4–8

outcome.zh: 在已经跑通的 H3 ComfyUI 基线上安装社区 Turbo 节点，用 6–8 步获得可用成片，并在爆显存时有明确降级顺序。
outcome.en: Add the community Turbo nodes to a working H3 ComfyUI baseline, render usable clips at 6–8 steps, and follow a controlled fallback order when VRAM runs out.

audience.zh: 已经能用官方 H3 工作流出片，但生成太慢或显存紧张的 NVIDIA 用户。
audience.en: NVIDIA users who can already render with the official H3 graph but need faster iteration or lower VRAM use.

hardware.zh: NVIDIA GPU；先记录原生工作流的峰值显存与耗时。低显存模式是兜底，不是默认画质选项。
hardware.en: An NVIDIA GPU. Record native peak VRAM and time first. Low-VRAM mode is a fallback, not the default quality setting.

zh: 第一条教程的原生 T2V 或 I2V 工作流已经稳定输出
固定 seed、Prompt、分辨率、时长和输入素材，便于 A/B 对比
ComfyUI-Manager 可用，或能手动安装 custom_nodes
从 Larryvrh 的 Hugging Face 仓库下载 minimax_h3_turbo_v4_step600_ema.safetensors
en: A stable native T2V or I2V workflow from the first guide
A fixed seed, prompt, resolution, duration, and input for A/B testing
ComfyUI-Manager or the ability to install custom_nodes manually
minimax_h3_turbo_v4_step600_ema.safetensors from Larryvrh's Hugging Face repository

zh: 先用原生 20 步工作流跑一次，记录总耗时、峰值显存、画面细节、快速运动和声音质量；这份结果是唯一基线。
在 ComfyUI-Manager 搜索 MiniMax-H3 Turbo 并安装；或在 ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ 克隆仓库。完成后彻底重启 ComfyUI，确认控制台没有导入错误。
把 minimax_h3_turbo_v4_step600_ema.safetensors 放入 ComfyUI/models/loras/。多数场景优先 v4-600；只有 4 步且高速大幅运动出现拖影时，才对比旧 v1-850。
从官方 T2V/I2V 图开始，在 Load Diffusion Model 与 SamplerCustomAdvanced 之间插入 MiniMax-H3 Turbo LoRA 节点，并选择刚放入的权重。
用 MiniMax-H3 Turbo Sampler 给 SamplerCustomAdvanced 提供 SAMPLER；BasicScheduler 设为 simple。其他 conditioning、双 VAE 解码和音频输出保持基线不变。
第一轮设 8 步、strength=1.0；成功后再试 6 步。4 步只用于快速构图预览或明确的低预算场景，不要默认把 4 步结果当最终质量。
用完全相同的 seed、Prompt、素材、分辨率和时长重新生成，比较耗时、脸手细节、快速运动拖影、音质与同步。一次只改 Turbo 这一个变量。
如果爆显存，先降低预览分辨率或时长，再关闭非必要预览/节点，最后才打开 low_vram。low_vram 会降低峰值显存，但量化输出可能更软。
如果画面拖影或模糊，可在明确问题片段把 strength 小幅提高到约 1.05–1.2；如果过锐和颗粒明显，降到约 0.8–0.95。每次只改一个参数。
保留原生与 Turbo 两份工作流。Turbo 用于选镜与批量预览，重要镜头仍与 20 步原生基线对比后再决定成片版本。
en: Run the native 20-step graph once and record total time, peak VRAM, fine detail, fast motion, and audio quality. This render is the only valid baseline.
Install MiniMax-H3 Turbo through ComfyUI-Manager, or clone it under ComfyUI/custom_nodes/. Fully restart ComfyUI and confirm there is no import error.
Place minimax_h3_turbo_v4_step600_ema.safetensors in ComfyUI/models/loras/. Prefer v4-600 for most work; compare the older v1-850 only when 4-step heavy motion shows trailing or smear.
Start from the official T2V or I2V graph. Insert MiniMax-H3 Turbo LoRA between Load Diffusion Model and SamplerCustomAdvanced, then select the downloaded checkpoint.
Feed SamplerCustomAdvanced from MiniMax-H3 Turbo Sampler and set BasicScheduler to simple. Keep conditioning, both VAE decoders, and audio output unchanged.
Start at 8 steps and strength=1.0, then test 6 steps. Use 4 steps for composition previews or strict budgets rather than assuming it is final quality.

Render again with the exact same seed, prompt, media, resolution, and duration. Compare time, face and hand detail, fast-motion trails, audio quality, and sync. Turbo must be the only changed variable.
If VRAM runs out, reduce preview resolution or duration first, disable nonessential previews or nodes second, and enable low_vram last. Low-VRAM mode lowers peak use but can soften quantized output.
For smear or blur on a specific clip, test strength around 1.05–1.2. For oversharp grain, test about 0.8–0.95. Change only one parameter per run.
Keep separate native and Turbo workflow files. Use Turbo for shot selection and bulk previews, then compare important finals against the native 20-step baseline.

zh: MiniMax-H3 Turbo LoRA 与 Turbo Sampler 两个节点都能搜索并加载
相同输入下，6–8 步 Turbo 成功输出带声 MP4
已保存原生与 Turbo 的耗时、峰值显存和质量对比
没有同时叠加 Spectrum、EasyCache 或其他未单独验证的加速器
en: Both MiniMax-H3 Turbo LoRA and Turbo Sampler nodes load successfully
The same input renders a video with audio at 6–8 Turbo steps
Native and Turbo time, peak VRAM, and quality comparisons are saved
Spectrum, EasyCache, and other untested accelerators are not stacked into this baseline

zh: 4–8 步是有效范围，6–8 步通常明显优于 4 步；超过 8 步不再带来稳定收益，还可能过锐。
strength 默认保持 1.0；只有具体片段出现拖影或过锐时才小幅调整。
low_vram 会以清晰度换显存，不要在显存足够时默认开启。
Turbo 的音质和高速运动仍在改进；不要把采样步数缩短直接宣传成等比例端到端加速。
不要把 Turbo、Spectrum、EasyCache 等全部叠加；优化器的误差与音频损失可能累积。
en: The useful range is 4–8 steps, with 6–8 usually much better than 4. Going above 8 adds no reliable benefit and may oversharpen.
Keep strength at 1.0 by default and tune only for a specific smear or oversharp failure.
low_vram trades sharpness for memory and should stay off when memory is sufficient.
Audio and intense fast motion remain active areas of improvement. Fewer sampling steps are not the same as proportional end-to-end speedup.
Do not stack Turbo, Spectrum, EasyCache, and other optimizers by default; their errors and audio losses can compound.

expectedResult.zh: 在相同 seed、输入、分辨率和时长下得到 6–8 步带声视频，并留下原生 20 步与 Turbo 的耗时和质量对照。
expectedResult.en: Render a 6–8 step video with audio from the same seed, input, resolution, and duration, with a native 20-step comparison saved beside it.

problem.zh: 新节点没有出现在搜索中
problem.en: The new nodes do not appear in search

solution.zh: 确认仓库位于 custom_nodes，查看启动日志中的导入错误并完全重启。
solution.en: Confirm the repository is under custom_nodes, inspect startup import errors, and fully restart.

problem.zh: 4 步画面拖影或声音变差
problem.en: Four-step output smears or loses audio quality

solution.zh: 先回到 8 步、strength 1.0；不要叠加 Spectrum 或 EasyCache。
solution.en: Return to eight steps at strength 1.0 and remove Spectrum or EasyCache from the comparison.

zh: 删除 ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-Turbo 并重启。
移除工作流中的 Turbo LoRA 与 Turbo Sampler 节点即可回到原生采样。
en: Delete ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-Turbo and restart.
Remove the Turbo LoRA and Turbo Sampler nodes to restore native sampling.

title.zh: Mac 从零运行 H3：纯 C + Metal
title.en: Run H3 on Mac from zero with pure C + Metal

outcome.zh: 不用 Python、PyTorch 或 ComfyUI，在 Apple Silicon 上编译 h3.c、检查模型，并生成第一条含声音的 MP4。
outcome.en: Without Python, PyTorch, or ComfyUI, compile h3.c on Apple Silicon, validate the model, and generate a first MP4 with audio.

audience.zh: 有 Apple Silicon Mac、能使用终端，但不想搭建 NVIDIA/ComfyUI 环境的用户。
audience.en: Apple Silicon users who can use Terminal and do not want to build an NVIDIA or ComfyUI stack.

hardware.zh: M 系列 Mac 与足够统一内存、磁盘空间；先跑 512×512、22 帧。不同芯片的速度与可用内存差异很大。
hardware.en: An M-series Mac with enough unified memory and storage. Start at 512×512 and 22 frames; speed and usable memory vary widely by chip.

zh: macOS、Git 与 Xcode Command Line Tools
FFmpeg 和 FFprobe 可从终端直接调用
完整 MiniMax-H3 Hugging Face snapshot，目录名设为 MiniMax-H3
关闭占用大量统一内存的应用，并为首次载入预留足够时间
en: macOS, Git, and Xcode Command Line Tools
FFmpeg and FFprobe callable from Terminal
A complete MiniMax-H3 Hugging Face snapshot in a MiniMax-H3 directory
Memory-heavy applications closed and enough time reserved for the first load

zh: 打开终端运行 xcode-select --install；若已安装会提示无需重复。安装 Homebrew 后执行 brew install ffmpeg，再分别检查 ffmpeg 和 ffprobe 版本。
克隆 antirez/h3.c 并进入目录。不要把仓库和模型权重混在同一层散放：教程默认模型完整位于 ./MiniMax-H3。
从 Hugging Face 下载 MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3 的完整 snapshot 到 ./MiniMax-H3。下载完成后不要改权重文件名，也不要只下载 README 中看起来像主模型的单个文件。
执行 make -j8 编译；创建 outputs 目录。若编译失败，先确认当前终端使用的是 Apple clang，并重新检查 Command Line Tools，而不是随意删除编译参数。
运行 ./h3 --info -d ./MiniMax-H3。它只核验模型布局并打印 Metal 设备，不会映射全部权重或开始生成；任何缺失文件都应在这一步解决。
先运行 512×512、22 帧、20 步的平衡示例。首次启动包含模型载入与文件缓存，不能用第一次总耗时代表稳定速度。
如果终端支持图形协议且统一内存充足，可保留 --show 查看中间帧；内存紧张时删除 --show，它会额外占用约 10 GiB 临时模型驻留。
确认 outputs/fox-fast.mp4 能播放且含声音。再以相同命令重复一次，第二次耗时才更适合与其他设置比较。
需要交互创作时运行 ./h3 -d ./MiniMax-H3 --width 512 --height 512 --steps 6。使用 !status、!seed random、!seconds 2 与 !save output.mp4 管理会话。
首尾帧使用 !first opening.png 与 !last ending.png；一般参考图使用 !ref-image person.png。Ref2VA 参考图不能和 !first/!last 同时使用，切换模式前先清理旧条件。
en: Run xcode-select --install in Terminal; macOS will say when it is already present. Install FFmpeg with Homebrew, then verify both ffmpeg and ffprobe.
Clone antirez/h3.c and enter the repository. Keep the code separate from the weight files; this guide expects the complete model at ./MiniMax-H3.
Download the complete MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3 Hugging Face snapshot into ./MiniMax-H3. Preserve filenames and do not download only the apparent main checkpoint.
Run make -j8, then create outputs. If compilation fails, confirm the active compiler is Apple clang and repair Command Line Tools before changing build flags.
Run ./h3 --info -d ./MiniMax-H3. It validates model layout and prints the Metal device without mapping every weight or generating media. Resolve missing files here.
Run the balanced 512×512, 22-frame, 20-step example first. The first invocation pays model-loading and filesystem-cache costs, so its total time is not a stable benchmark.
Keep --show only when the terminal supports graphical protocols and unified memory is sufficient. Remove it under memory pressure because preview adds about 10 GiB of temporary model residency.
Confirm outputs/fox-fast.mp4 plays with audio. Repeat the same command; the second run is a more useful performance comparison.
For interactive work, run ./h3 -d ./MiniMax-H3 --width 512 --height 512 --steps 6. Use !status, !seed random, !seconds 2, and !save output.mp4 to control the session.
Use !first opening.png and !last ending.png for boundary frames, or !ref-image person.png for a general reference. Ref2VA references cannot be mixed with !first or !last; clear the old mode first.

commands: ./h3 --profile -d ./MiniMax-H3 -p "A red fox walks through fresh snow in a pine forest. Medium tracking shot, natural winter light, realistic fur, soft footsteps and wind." --width 512 --height 512 --frames 22 --steps 20 --layers 45 --reuse 2 -o outputs/fox-fast.mp4

zh: ./h3 --info 能识别完整模型目录并打印 Apple Metal 设备
outputs/fox-fast.mp4 可播放、含画面和声音，时长约 0.92 秒
相同命令第二次运行成功，并记录了不含首次载入开销的耗时
交互模式能接受 Prompt，并能用 !save 保存指定文件
en: ./h3 --info accepts the complete model directory and prints the Apple Metal device
outputs/fox-fast.mp4 plays with picture and audio for roughly 0.92 seconds
A second identical run succeeds and its time excludes most first-load overhead
Interactive mode accepts a prompt and !save writes the requested file

zh: h3.c 正在快速迭代；权重布局、命令参数和性能结论必须以当前 README 为准。
--show 是可选预览，不是生成所必需；它会增加解码时间和约 10 GiB 临时内存占用。
4 步适合极快预览，但细节与运动质量低于 20 步；不要把不同步数结果当同质量比较。
Apple Silicon 使用统一内存；系统剩余内存不足时，交换与热降频会让结果远慢于公开基准。
en: h3.c evolves quickly; verify weight layout, CLI flags, and performance claims against the current README.
--show is an optional preview, not a generation requirement; it adds decode time and about 10 GiB of temporary memory.
Four steps are useful for very fast previews but lose detail and motion quality versus 20; do not compare them as equal-quality runs.
Apple Silicon uses unified memory. Low free memory, swapping, and thermal throttling can make a run far slower than public benchmarks.

expectedResult.zh: h3 --info 识别模型与 Metal 设备，并生成 outputs/fox-fast.mp4；文件包含可解码的视频轨和声音轨。
expectedResult.en: h3 --info identifies the model and Metal device, and outputs/fox-fast.mp4 contains decodable video and audio tracks.

problem.zh: 编译器或 Metal 构建失败

solution.zh: 重新运行 xcode-select --install，确认使用 Apple clang，再执行 make clean 后重新编译。
solution.en: Run xcode-select --install, confirm Apple clang is active, then run make clean and rebuild.

solution.zh: 重新核对完整 Hugging Face snapshot，不要只下载主权重或修改文件名。
solution.en: Recheck the complete Hugging Face snapshot; do not download only the main checkpoint or rename files.

zh: 删除 h3.c 工作目录即可移除程序；模型目录可独立保留。

title.zh: Motion Context：把两段 H3 接成长视频
title.en: Motion Context: chain H3 clips into a longer video

outcome.zh: 安装 Motion Context 节点，用上一段的音画 latent 续接下一段，完成一次画面与声音都连续的两段拼接。
outcome.en: Install Motion Context, carry the previous audio-video latent into the next generation, and complete a two-clip chain with continuous picture and sound.

audience.zh: 已经能在 ComfyUI 稳定生成单段 H3，想突破单次时长而不接受明显画面接缝或声音重启的用户。
audience.en: ComfyUI users with a stable single-clip H3 workflow who need longer sequences without obvious picture seams or restarted audio.

hardware.zh: 能稳定运行 H3 的 NVIDIA 环境；两段必须保持完全相同的分辨率，建议先用短片和原生采样验证。
hardware.en: An NVIDIA setup that already runs H3 reliably. Both clips must use identical resolution; validate with short native-sampling clips first.

zh: 可运行的 T2V、I2V 或 Ref2VA H3 ComfyUI 工作流
ComfyUI 0.32 或 0.33；升级后需重新核验节点兼容性
第一段的完整 latent、画面和音频输出
提前写好两段 Prompt，第二段开头保留上一段结尾的构图与人物关系
en: A working T2V, I2V, or Ref2VA H3 ComfyUI workflow
ComfyUI 0.32 or 0.33, with compatibility rechecked after updates
The first clip's complete latent plus decoded picture and audio
Two planned prompts whose second opening preserves the first clip's closing composition and relationships

zh: 把 ComfyUI-H3-Motion-Context 克隆到 ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ 并重启。控制台应显示 h3_motion_context: nodes registered；出现冲突时先移除重复安装或实现同类 patch 的节点包。
复制已经跑通的 H3 工作流作为长视频专用版本。把 H3 conditioning 接入 H3 Motion Context，再把它的输出接回 guider/sampler；不要直接改动原始基线。
在采样器后加入 H3 Motion Context Save Latent。第一段设 Save clip_index=1，context_latent 保持未连接；正常生成第一段并保留其 decoded IMAGE、AUDIO 与 latent。
第二段加入 H3 Motion Context Load Latent，Load clip_index=1，输出只接 H3 Motion Context 的 context_latent。不要把它接到普通 Decode；原生 Save/Load Latent 也不能处理 H3 成对的音画 latent。
把当前第二段采样器输出同时接到 Save Latent，并设 Save clip_index=2。这样重试第二段时仍会读取 clip 1，只覆盖 clip 2；接受结果后再把 Load/Save 编号一起向前移动。
将解码后的 IMAGE 和 AUDIO 接入 H3 Motion Context Trim，并把 Motion Context 输出的 trim_frames 连过去。Trim 必须同时裁画面和声音，否则上下文帧会重复出现在成片开头。
使用起始参数：context_length=22、audio_context_length=24、match_tail=on，分辨率与上一段完全一致，Spectrum=off。22 帧会从交付的第二段开头裁掉约 0.92 秒。
写第二段 Prompt 时，开头先保持上一段结束构图约 2 秒，不立刻换景或增加新人；让演员有呼吸、重心移动或视线变化，避免静帧。之后再明确切镜与新动作。
生成第二段后，先分别播放裁切前后结果，检查接缝画面、动作方向、声音波形/节拍和响度。满意后再用无重编码或统一参数的工具拼接两段。
继续第三段时 Load clip_index=2、Save clip_index=3。链越长越要逐段试听；声音高频会逐渐变钝，适合在自然音乐转场处开启新链，而不是无限续接。
en: Clone ComfyUI-H3-Motion-Context into ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ and restart. The console should report h3_motion_context: nodes registered. Remove duplicate installs or another pack that owns the same patch when it reports a conflict.
Duplicate the working H3 graph for long-video experiments. Route H3 conditioning into H3 Motion Context and its output back to the guider or sampler, leaving the original baseline untouched.
Add H3 Motion Context Save Latent after the sampler. Set Save clip_index=1 for clip one and leave context_latent disconnected. Generate clip one and retain its decoded IMAGE, AUDIO, and latent.

For clip two, add H3 Motion Context Load Latent with Load clip_index=1 and connect its output only to Motion Context context_latent. Do not decode it or replace these nodes with stock Save/Load Latent, which cannot carry H3's paired video-audio latent.
Also route the current clip-two sampler output to Save Latent with Save clip_index=2. A retry still loads clip one and overwrites clip two; after approval, advance both indices together.
Route decoded IMAGE and AUDIO through H3 Motion Context Trim and connect trim_frames from Motion Context. Trim both picture and sound or the pinned context repeats at the new clip's beginning.
Start with context_length=22, audio_context_length=24, match_tail on, exactly the same resolution, and Spectrum off. A 22-frame head removes about 0.92 seconds from delivered clip two.

Open the second prompt by holding the prior closing composition for about two seconds. Do not immediately change rooms or add people; include a breath, weight shift, or eyeline move to avoid a frozen hold, then introduce the new shot.
After rendering clip two, compare untrimmed and trimmed output for picture seams, motion direction, audio waveform or beat, and loudness. Concatenate only after the join passes.

For clip three, load index 2 and save index 3. Listen critically as the chain grows because audio high frequencies can soften; restart the chain at a natural musical transition instead of continuing forever.

zh: 启动日志显示 Motion Context 节点注册成功，且没有重复 patch 冲突
clip 2 明确从 clip 1 的 latent 读取，Save/Load clip_index 配对正确
Trim 同时处理 IMAGE 与 AUDIO，成片开头没有重复的 22 帧
拼接点的构图、运动方向和声音连续，没有明显静帧、响度跳变或重新起奏
en: Startup logs show Motion Context nodes registered without a duplicate-patch conflict
Clip two clearly loads clip one's latent and the Save/Load indices are paired correctly
Trim processes both IMAGE and AUDIO with no repeated 22-frame head in the delivered clip
The join preserves composition, motion direction, and audio without an obvious freeze, loudness step, or restarted performance

zh: 必须使用项目自己的 Save/Load Latent；ComfyUI 原生节点不能保存 H3 成对的音画 latent。
latent 不能缩放，链中分辨率不一致时节点会拒绝运行；需要改分辨率就从新链开始。
链式生成会累积模型平滑，声音高频尤其容易逐段变闷；长作品需规划重新起链的位置。
Turbo 与 Spectrum 都会损失音频细节，二者叠加会进一步放大问题；这条基线先关闭 Spectrum。
ComfyUI 更新可能改变节点布局。升级后若组件位置错乱，删除旧 Motion Context 节点、重新添加并接线。
en: Use this project's Save/Load Latent nodes; stock ComfyUI nodes cannot store H3's paired audio-video latent.
Latents cannot be resized, so a resolution mismatch is rejected. Start a new chain when changing resolution.
Model smoothing compounds down a chain, especially in audio high frequencies. Plan natural points to restart long sequences.
Turbo and Spectrum both reduce audio detail and stack badly. Keep Spectrum off for this baseline.
ComfyUI updates can change stored widget positions. After an upgrade, delete old Motion Context nodes, add them again, and rewire.

expectedResult.zh: 第二段延续第一段的运动方向与声音，并在 Trim 后移除重复上下文；两段分辨率一致、接缝可检查。
expectedResult.en: Clip B continues clip A's motion direction and sound, duplicate context is removed after Trim, and both clips share one resolution with an inspectable join.

problem.zh: Load Latent 形成循环连接
problem.en: Load Latent creates a circular graph

solution.zh: 使用插件自带的 Save/Load Latent 跨运行传递，并明确设置上一段与当前段的 clip_index。
solution.en: Use the pack's Save/Load Latent nodes across runs and set the previous/current clip_index explicitly.

problem.en: The join repeats or audio drifts

solution.zh: 把 trim_frames 接到 Motion Context Trim，保持 match_tail，并从 22 帧视频、24 帧音频上下文重新测试。
solution.en: Wire trim_frames into Motion Context Trim, keep match_tail enabled, and retry with 22 video and 24 audio context frames.

zh: 删除 ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-H3-Motion-Context 并重启。
移除 Motion Context、Save/Load Latent 与 Trim 节点后恢复普通 H3 图。
en: Delete ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-H3-Motion-Context and restart.
Remove Motion Context, Save/Load Latent, and Trim nodes to restore a standard H3 graph.

zh: T8 音画节点
官方 H3 工作流
固定音画测试 Prompt
en: The T8 audio-video nodes
A native H3 workflow
A fixed audio-video test prompt

zh: 先确认官方 H3 ComfyUI 基线可以输出带声 MP4，并保存固定 seed、Prompt、画布、帧数和 20 步结果。
在 ComfyUI Manager 搜索 MiniMax H3 Audio T8，或用 comfy CLI 安装；完成后彻底重启 ComfyUI。
打开 examples/workflows/01-basic-generation，替换成自己的模型与素材；首轮使用 22 帧、小画布和 stock sampler。
先接 MiniMaxH3AudioConditioningT8、MiniMaxH3DualClockSamplerT8、MiniMaxH3AVDecodeT8 和 MiniMaxH3PreflightT8，运行预检并修复尺寸、标签或显存错误。
固定视频步数，只改变音频时钟；再固定音频步数，只改变视频时钟。每次记录总耗时、声音清晰度、事件同步和输出轨道信息。
只有稳定链路通过后才加入 Turbo LoRA；实验节点、SageAttention 和长视频链路分开验证，不在第一轮叠加。
en: Confirm the official H3 ComfyUI baseline outputs an MP4 with audio, then save its seed, prompt, canvas, frame count, and 20-step result.
Find MiniMax H3 Audio T8 in ComfyUI Manager or install it with the comfy CLI, then fully restart ComfyUI.
Open examples/workflows/01-basic-generation and replace the models and media. Start with 22 frames, a small canvas, and the stock sampler.
Wire MiniMaxH3AudioConditioningT8, MiniMaxH3DualClockSamplerT8, MiniMaxH3AVDecodeT8, and MiniMaxH3PreflightT8 first. Run preflight and fix size, tag, or VRAM errors.
Hold video steps constant while changing the audio clock, then reverse the test. Record total time, speech clarity, event sync, and output stream metadata each time.
Add Turbo LoRA only after the stable path passes. Test experimental nodes, SageAttention, and long-video graphs separately rather than stacking them in the first run.

zh: 启动日志显示插件成功注册且没有导入错误

基础双时钟工作流输出含视频轨和 32kHz 立体声音频轨

solution.zh: 检查 <Picture 1>、<Video 1>、<Audio 1> 的编号与实际接入顺序，多个参考输入不得省略编号。
solution.en: Match <Picture 1>, <Video 1>, and <Audio 1> numbering to the wired inputs; do not omit indices with multiple references.

solution.zh: 保存完整 Error Report，从 22 帧小画布和稳定节点重跑，并清理实验 patch 与缓存。
solution.en: Save the complete Error Report, retry at 22 frames on a small canvas with stable nodes, and remove experimental patches and stale caches.

zh: 删除 ComfyUI/custom_nodes/minimax-h3-audio-T8 后重启。
可选提示词重写器依赖只在使用该功能时安装，不要为基础音频工作流全局升级 Transformers。
en: Delete ComfyUI/custom_nodes/minimax-h3-audio-T8 and restart.
Install optional prompt-rewriter dependencies only when using that feature; do not globally upgrade Transformers for the base audio graph.

title.zh: RTX 4080 16GB：Pruned + INT8 低显存部署
title.en: RTX 4080 16GB: pruned plus INT8 low-VRAM setup

outcome.zh: 在 16GB 显存上跑通 10 秒本地 H3 测试。
outcome.en: Run a ten-second local H3 test within 16GB VRAM.

audience.zh: 4080 16GB 或相近显存、需要低显存路线的用户。
audience.en: Users around 16GB VRAM who need a reduced-memory path.

hardware.en: RTX 4080 16GB as reported by the source; roughly ten minutes for a ten-second clip.

zh: ComfyUI 原生工作流
匹配的 pruned 与 INT8 权重
正确模型目录
en: The native ComfyUI workflow
Matching pruned and INT8 weights
Correct model directories

zh: 记录原帖的 4080 16GB 结果只作为硬件快照，不把约 10 分钟耗时当成所有机器的承诺。
从源码安装 DiffSynth-Studio，并额外安装 quant 依赖；使用独立 Python 环境，避免改坏现有 ComfyUI。
打开低显存示例 MiniMax-H3-Int8-ConvRot-Pruned-FL2VA.py，先核对模型 ID、origin_file_pattern、vram_limit 与输出路径。
先运行示例默认的短片和低画布；监控峰值显存、系统内存、下载与 VAE 解码，不要一开始改成 10 秒或原生高分辨率。
确认 MP4 含视频与声音后，再固定 seed 逐步增加帧数或画布。一次只改一个规模参数，并保留 OOM 前最后成功配置。
量化结果与原生基线使用相同 Prompt、seed 和输出规格做画质与声音对照，不能只以能跑通判断质量。
en: Treat the source's RTX 4080 16GB result as a hardware snapshot, not a universal ten-minute promise.
Install DiffSynth-Studio from source with its quant extras in a separate Python environment so the ComfyUI environment remains untouched.
Open MiniMax-H3-Int8-ConvRot-Pruned-FL2VA.py under model_inference_low_vram and verify model IDs, origin_file_pattern, vram_limit, and output path.
Run the example first at its short duration and small canvas. Monitor peak VRAM, system memory, downloads, and VAE decode before increasing duration or resolution.
After an MP4 with video and audio succeeds, hold the seed constant and increase frames or canvas one variable at a time. Keep the last successful configuration before OOM.
Compare quantized and native outputs with the same prompt, seed, and output specification; fitting in memory is not a quality verdict.

zh: 量化依赖可以导入且低显存示例开始加载匹配的 FL2VA 权重
一次短片成功输出含视频轨和声音轨的 MP4
已记录峰值显存、总耗时、画布、帧数与 seed
与原生基线的画面和声音差异已人工检查
en: Quantization dependencies import and the low-VRAM example loads matching FL2VA weights
A short run produces an MP4 with video and audio streams
Peak VRAM, total time, canvas, frames, and seed are recorded
Visual and audio differences from the native baseline are reviewed

zh: 量化与剪枝可能影响质量；先复现，再做画质判断。
en: Quantization and pruning may affect quality; reproduce first, then evaluate.

testedVersions: INT8 ConvRot pruned FL2VA low-VRAM example

problem.zh: comfy-kitchen 或量化后端无法导入
problem.en: comfy-kitchen or the quant backend will not import

solution.en: Install diffsynth[quant] inside the isolated DiffSynth environment and match Torch/CUDA to the GPU.

problem.en: The model loads but generation OOMs

solution.en: Return to the example's default canvas and frames, close competing GPU processes, and scale one step at a time.

en: Remove the isolated DiffSynth environment and repository; do not bulk-uninstall dependencies from the ComfyUI environment.

title.zh: 4-bit + DiffSynth：最低 8GB 显存路线
title.en: 4-bit plus DiffSynth: an 8GB-VRAM route

outcome.zh: 通过 4-bit 量化与显存自适应推理在更小显存上运行 H3。
outcome.en: Run H3 on smaller GPUs through 4-bit quantization and VRAM-adaptive inference.

audience.zh: 8GB 显存或希望在 Mac 上尝试量化 H3 的用户。
audience.en: Users with 8GB VRAM or those testing a quantized H3 path on Mac.

hardware.zh: 最低 8GB VRAM 为来源公布下限；实际速度和可用模式需复核。
hardware.en: The source reports an 8GB minimum; verify actual speed and supported modes.

zh: DiffSynth-Studio
匹配的 4-bit H3 权重
足够系统内存与磁盘
en: DiffSynth-Studio
Matching 4-bit H3 weights
Enough system memory and storage

zh: 新建独立 Python 环境，从源码安装 DiffSynth-Studio；先查看 H3 文档当前是否仍标注 NF4 最低约 7GB VRAM。
打开 model_inference_low_vram/MiniMax-H3-NF4-FL2VA.py，保留四个 NF4 模型文件的匹配 origin_file_pattern。
让 vram_limit 使用可用显存减 2GB 的文档默认策略；不要伪装或硬编码比物理显存更大的数值。
第一轮使用 480×832、124 帧或示例更小设置，固定 seed，等待模型按需在 CPU/GPU 间调度。
用 ffprobe 检查输出 t2va.mp4 的视频、24fps、32kHz 立体声音频轨，并人工试听同步。
低显存基线通过后再分别尝试 Ref2VA、画布或帧数；记录每次总耗时和系统内存，避免只报告 GPU 显存。
en: Create an isolated Python environment and install DiffSynth-Studio from source. Confirm the current H3 documentation still reports an approximately 7GB NF4 minimum.
Open model_inference_low_vram/MiniMax-H3-NF4-FL2VA.py and preserve the four matching NF4 origin_file_pattern values.
Keep the documented vram_limit strategy of available VRAM minus 2GB; never spoof a limit larger than physical memory.
Start at 480×832 and 124 frames or the example's smaller setting, hold the seed constant, and allow CPU/GPU parameter movement to finish.
Use ffprobe to confirm t2va.mp4 contains video, 24fps, and a 32kHz stereo audio stream, then listen for sync.
After the low-VRAM baseline passes, test Ref2VA, canvas, or frame count separately. Record total time and system memory instead of reporting GPU VRAM alone.

zh: NF4 四个组件与 FL2VA processor 成功加载
任务没有伪造 vram_limit，且在物理显存范围内完成
t2va.mp4 包含视频与 32kHz 立体声音频
已记录 GPU 显存、系统内存、总耗时与量化质量差异
en: All four NF4 components plus the FL2VA processor load
The job completes within physical VRAM without spoofing vram_limit
t2va.mp4 contains video and 32kHz stereo audio
GPU VRAM, system memory, total time, and quantization differences are recorded

zh: 低显存可运行不等于速度快；量化质量与原生模型不同。
en: Running in low VRAM does not imply speed, and quantized quality differs from native weights.

expectedResult.zh: 在约 7–8GB 可用显存的 NVIDIA 环境完成一条 NF4 FL2VA 带声短片，并清楚记录速度与质量代价。
expectedResult.en: Complete one NF4 FL2VA short video with audio in an NVIDIA environment with roughly 7–8GB usable VRAM, with speed and quality costs documented.

problem.zh: 下载或载入 NF4 组件失败
problem.en: An NF4 component fails to download or load

solution.zh: 逐一核对四个 origin_file_pattern 与模型 ID；FL2VA 和 Ref2VA 组件不能混用。
solution.en: Check each of the four origin_file_pattern values and model IDs; do not mix FL2VA and Ref2VA components.

problem.en: VRAM fits but the system stalls

solution.zh: 量化低显存依赖 CPU offload；检查系统内存和交换空间，减小画布或帧数后重试。
solution.en: Low-VRAM quantization relies on CPU offload; inspect system RAM and swap, then reduce canvas or frames.

zh: 删除独立 DiffSynth 环境与下载缓存前先确认其他模型未共用。
en: Before removing the isolated DiffSynth environment and download cache, confirm no other model shares them.

title.zh: 用 AI Toolkit 训练 H3 Ref2VA LoRA
title.en: Train a MiniMax H3 Ref2VA LoRA with AI Toolkit

outcome.zh: 为视频到视频任务准备数据，并完成一次可审计的 Ref2VA LoRA 训练。
outcome.en: Prepare a video-to-video dataset and run an auditable Ref2VA LoRA training experiment.

audience.zh: 有训练经验、数据和高显存 GPU 的开发者。
audience.en: Developers with training experience, data, and a high-memory GPU.

hardware.zh: 高显存 NVIDIA GPU；具体要求以 AI Toolkit 与当前 H3 训练文档为准。
hardware.en: A high-memory NVIDIA GPU; use current AI Toolkit and H3 training docs for exact requirements.

zh: 有权使用的视频数据
AI Toolkit 当前版本
基础模型许可已核对
en: Video data you are allowed to use
A current AI Toolkit release
The base-model license has been reviewed

zh: 先阅读 H3 Community License 和训练仓库限制；确认训练视频、声音、人物与衍生权重都有合法使用范围。
克隆 MiniMax-H3-FineTuning，在 Python 3.11 环境运行 install_env.sh；它会安装仓库固定的 Diffusers 集成，不要改成普通已发布 wheel。
按照 examples 中的 schema 创建 train.jsonl，用 validate_manifest.py 检查字段与所有媒体文件。训练/验证样本必须能追溯。
先以 256×256、22 帧运行 prepare_cache.py，并启用 encode-text 与 encode-audio；检查每条样本生成一个缓存文件。
使用 trainable=heads、max-steps=10 做单卡 smoke test。只有 loss 保持有限、checkpoint 写入、所有 rank 同步完成，才进入 LoRA。
准备固定验证集并保留 seed；LoRA 训练前明确 17n+5 帧约束、32 像素倍数、24fps、32kHz 立体声和序列 token 预算。
生产 LoRA 使用 DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 与仓库脚本，从短 run 开始；保存训练日志、VAL 曲线、版本、数据指纹和恢复点。
把 LoRA 接回匹配的 Ref2VA 推理路径，在固定样例上同时比较参考遵循、画面、运动、声音和过拟合；不只看训练 loss。
en: Read the H3 Community License and repository limitations first. Confirm rights for training video, audio, people, and derivative weights.
Clone MiniMax-H3-FineTuning and run install_env.sh under Python 3.11. It installs a pinned Diffusers integration; do not replace it with the regular released wheel.
Create train.jsonl from the examples schema and validate every field and media file with validate_manifest.py. Training and validation samples must remain traceable.
Run prepare_cache.py first at 256×256 and 22 frames with encode-text and encode-audio. Confirm every sample produces one cache file.
Run a one-GPU smoke test with trainable=heads and max-steps=10. Move to LoRA only when loss stays finite, a checkpoint writes, and all ranks finish together.
Prepare a fixed validation set and seed. Before LoRA, document 17n+5 frames, dimensions divisible by 32, 24fps, 32kHz stereo, and the sequence-token budget.
Use DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 and the repository script for production LoRA, beginning with a short run. Save logs, VAL curves, versions, data fingerprints, and recovery checkpoints.
Load the LoRA into the matching Ref2VA inference path and compare reference adherence, picture, motion, audio, and overfitting on fixed samples rather than relying on training loss alone.

commands: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python train.py --model /path/to/MiniMax-H3 --variant ref2va --cache cache/train --output runs/smoke --max-steps 10 --trainable heads --strategy ddp
deepspeed --num_gpus 8 train.py --model /path/to/MiniMax-H3 --variant ref2va --cache cache/train --output runs/lora --max-steps 800 --trainable lora --strategy deepspeed

zh: manifest 校验通过且所有训练媒体都有权利记录
缓存数量与有效样本数量一致，音频没有被零占位误当作真实输入
10 步 heads smoke test loss 有限且 checkpoint 可读取
固定验证集、环境版本、数据指纹与恢复点均已保存
en: The manifest validates and every training asset has a rights record
Cache count matches valid samples and zero-placeholder audio is not mistaken for real audio
The ten-step heads smoke loss stays finite and its checkpoint can be read
The fixed validation set, environment versions, data fingerprint, and recovery point are saved

zh: 训练会消耗大量算力；数据版权和模型许可必须先确认。
en: Training is compute-intensive; confirm dataset rights and model licensing first.

expectedResult.zh: 完成一次可审计的 heads smoke test 与一个短 LoRA run，保留有效 loss、固定验证结果、checkpoint、版本和数据指纹。
expectedResult.en: Complete an auditable heads smoke test and short LoRA run with finite loss, fixed validation output, checkpoints, versions, and a data fingerprint.

problem.zh: loss 上升或快速变成 NaN
problem.en: Loss rises or becomes NaN quickly

solution.zh: 停止训练并核对仓库 FIXES.md 中的 timestep 方向、velocity 符号、音频权重和缓存格式，不要继续烧算力。
solution.en: Stop and check FIXES.md for timestep direction, velocity sign, audio weighting, and cache format before spending more compute.

solution.zh: 用 H3_MAX_LF 和 --max-seq-tokens 限制序列，降低分辨率/时长；记录跳过样本，不静默丢数据。
solution.en: Use H3_MAX_LF and --max-seq-tokens, reduce resolution or duration, and record skipped samples rather than dropping them silently.

zh: 停止所有训练进程后删除独立虚拟环境、cache 与 runs；先备份配置、日志和需要保留的 checkpoint。
en: Stop every training process, then remove the isolated environment, cache, and runs after backing up configs, logs, and required checkpoints.

title.zh: H3 WebUI：Motion Context + 内置升频
title.en: H3 WebUI: Motion Context plus built-in upscaling

outcome.zh: 通过 Motion Context 把短片续接到最长约一分钟，并在导出前升频。
outcome.en: Chain short clips toward roughly one minute with Motion Context and upscale before export.

短片分段计划
足够的生成和升频时间
en: H3 WebUI 1.4 or newer
A short-clip segment plan
Enough time for generation and upscaling

开启 Motion Context 并分段生成，逐段检查接缝。
最后再启用内置升频，不把升频问题混入生成调参。

Enable Motion Context and generate in segments while checking each join.
Apply built-in upscaling last so its artifacts do not confuse generation tuning.

en: Maximum duration and speed claims are version snapshots; recheck after updates.

outcome.zh: 在单次 13 秒无法生成时，用 Turbo 8 步与 Motion Context 分块完成。
outcome.en: When a 13-second pass does not fit, use eight-step Turbo and Motion Context chunks.

audience.zh: 12GB 显存、需要角色替换或长动作连续性的用户。
audience.en: 12GB users who need character replacement or longer motion continuity.

hardware.zh: RTX 4070 12GB + 32GB RAM（原帖实测）。
hardware.en: RTX 4070 12GB plus 32GB RAM, as reported by the source.

en: A Ref2VA workflow

zh: 把长动作切成三个约 5 秒区段。
用 Ref2VA 保持角色与动作参考，使用 8 步 Turbo 生成。
用 Motion Context 续接并检查动作、声音与身份边界。
en: Split the longer motion into roughly five-second sections.
Use Ref2VA for character and motion reference with eight-step Turbo.
Chain with Motion Context and inspect motion, audio, and identity at every join.

zh: 原帖约 30 分钟是单一硬件实测；分块重叠和接缝需要人工检查。
en: The roughly 30-minute time is hardware-specific; overlaps and joins require review.

title.zh: 4 步与 8 步 LoRA：用 30 秒续接做 A/B
title.en: Four-step vs eight-step LoRA: a 30-second chaining A/B

outcome.zh: 比较 lightx2v 与 larryvrh LoRA 在清晰度、噪声、语音和稳定性上的差异。
outcome.en: Compare lightx2v and larryvrh LoRAs for sharpness, noise, speech, and stability.

audience.zh: 已经能运行 Motion Context、正在选择 Turbo 权重的用户。
audience.en: Users with Motion Context working who are choosing a Turbo weight.

hardware.zh: 取决于 H3 WebUI 或 ComfyUI 当前路线。
hardware.en: Depends on the current H3 WebUI or ComfyUI path.

zh: 同一 Prompt、seed 与参考素材
两套待比较 LoRA
30 秒分段续接基线
en: The same prompt, seed, and references
Both LoRAs under test
A 30-second chained baseline

zh: 固定全部输入和 Motion Context 参数。
分别测试 4 步与 8 步，并记录 LoRA 强度。
从清晰度、噪声、语音与接缝稳定性四项选择，不只看速度。
en: Fix every input and Motion Context parameter.
Test four and eight steps separately and record LoRA strength.
Choose by sharpness, noise, speech, and join stability—not speed alone.

zh: 原作者结论属于其 WebUI 与当时权重版本，不能替代本机 A/B。
en: The source's conclusion reflects its WebUI and weight versions; it does not replace a local A/B.
